The '''Shadow Cairn''' was a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] monument in the [[Riverfall Wilds]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] that was in ruins by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. A stone road was originally lined by pillars carved with Sith runes, but the path and the pillars were cracked and broken by the Cold War. The large statue of a seated Sith was still intact by that time, and [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] spies used that area as a base.
